basic_info.description: Enviably situated on a peaceful residential block in the Lower Haight section of Hayes Valley, this iconic 3-unit Edwardian triplex features 3 spacious full-floor flats, including a vacant & nicely updated lower flat. The vacant flat features brand-new wide plank flooring, a renovated eat-in gas kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless appliances, tile backsplash & ample cabinetry. With new modern light fixtures throughout, the unit also includes 3 bedrooms with deep closets, a split bathroom, and a sunroom/office with southern exposure. Upstairs two tenant occupied 2nd & 3rd full floor flats each feature 2 bedrooms, formal living & dining rooms (or optional 3rd bedrooms) & split bathrooms. Downstairs offers abundant vacant space, including a large garage, multiple finished storage rooms, a half bath, a spacious laundry area, and a newly landscaped rear garden, offering flexible options for an expansive house-like owner-occupied unit with two rental units above, or a terrific investment opportunity w/ immediate income potential. With a walk score of 99, this vibrant location is steps from Haight St. shops, Hayes Valley boutiques, Duboce & Alamo Square parks, and public transit, w/ easy access to the 101 freeway, and the Bay Bridge.  Run don't walk to this fabulous opportunity!
